text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year! Thanks for coming to our party!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond has invited me to a New Year's party held by the Satono Group.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's apparently a gathering for members of the Satono family and affiliates of the Satono Group to exchange greetings for the new year.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Sorry for dropping this on you so suddenly, but my parents expressed that they would like to make your acquaintance, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Dia's Father
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year! Thank you for taking such good care of Dia.

text_block_list.name: Dia's Father
text_block_list.text: She's performed far better than we could have imagined in her classic year, and I'm sure your guidance played no small role in that.

text_block_list.name: Dia's Father
text_block_list.text: It looks like Dia's intuition was spot-on. We hope you'll continue guiding her toward success in her senior year as well.
choice_data_list: Thank you. I'll do all I can to make her into an illustrious runner.

text_block_list.name: Dia's Father
text_block_list.text: I've got great expectations for the both of you.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I have to make the rounds and say hello to everyone, so please excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Please go ahead and enjoy yourself!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her parents hold a central position within the group. As their daughter, it seems Satono Diamond also bears a significant amount of that responsibility.

text_block_list.name: Dia's Former Coach
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year, Dia! You're really making a name for yourself in the Twinkle Series, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Dia's Former Doctor
text_block_list.text: Hehe. You were such a small child, but now you've grown into a remarkable individual. I'm filled with pride every time I see you race.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year. It's lovely to see you both again.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I've been able to improve my running from the foundation that you both helped me set. I'm eternally grateful for everything you've done for me.

text_block_list.name: Dia's Former Coach
text_block_list.text: To tell you the truth, I brag to my current students about how I used to coach you! They're always so impressed with me when I do!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Oh my, I'm honored. ♪ But you were already well-known for your skills long before you ever took me under your wing!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: And you're a distinguished professor in the field of nutrition, Doctor. If anything, people envy me for having you and your team.

text_block_list.name: Dia's Former Doctor
text_block_list.text: Goodness, what a charmer. You've become a fantastic representative for the Satono Group!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Thank you, but I still have much to learn.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I'm still trying to figure out what an "illustrious runner" ought to do.

text_block_list.name: Dia's Former Coach
text_block_list.text: An illustrious runner, eh? Well, you'd probably need to consider running internationally one day, wouldn't you?

text_block_list.name: Sporting Goods Sales Rep
text_block_list.text: If you're thinking of competing overseas, our company stocks training goods and shoes aimed at the international market.

text_block_list.name: Sporting Goods Sales Rep
text_block_list.text: We could even develop custom items specifically for you, Miss Diamond. Please feel free to contact us anytime.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: The training equipment your company designed for us still gets a lot of use in our house even now.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Should I find myself in need of new equipment, would it be all right to ask you to develop something for me?

text_block_list.name: Sporting Goods Sales Rep
text_block_list.text: But of course. After all, you are the shining star of the Satono Group. We would be honored to do our very utmost to assist you.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much. I appreciate that. I'll be in contact with you in the near future. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A top-class coach, a first-rate doctor, and the backing of a sporting brand…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond has been blessed with much support since childhood. This just proves how much people have always expected of her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But such blessings come with a great deal of responsibility. She must repay the support she has received with concrete achievements, regardless of her own dreams and desires.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I have to ensure she achieves success in her senior year!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After the party, I head out with Satono Diamond to go on our first shrine visit of the year.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: You prayed for quite a long time.
choice_data_list: I was just reaffirming my commitments for the year.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Are you talking about my races?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I would have liked to pray together with you in that case…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: But that's all right. I got to see you looking incredibly serious instead, so I'll count that as a win. ♪ Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: What are your plans after this?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: If you don't mind me asking, I'd like to hear how you usually spend New Year's!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Both my family and Kita's customarily host huge parties.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I'm interested in learning about different ways to celebrate New Year's outside of parties and banquets. And if it's all right, I'd love to join you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I thought we were simply chatting, but Satono Diamond ends up deciding to spend the rest of New Year's with me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As for how I usually spend the holiday…
choice_data_list: I usually go buy a lucky bag.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: What? You mean, you just sleep through it? Is that some kind of training to make your first dream of the year a good one?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I hastily explain that while I do occasionally hit the sack early on New Year's, I meant I usually stay at home and laze around.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Wow, so you start off your new year by loafing about? That sounds so indulgent! ♪ Count me in!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We decide to set up camp in my office and eat snacks while watching New Year's specials on TV.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: These people are walking an awful lot for being on a bus tour…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: That eel lunch box looks scrumptious!
choice_data_list: Makes your mouth water, doesn't it?
Makes your mouth water, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: It looks like they're open today, so why don't we get some delivered?
choice_data_list: We're way too far from them to get delivery!
We're way too far from them to get delivery!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: That's no problem. We've both been working really hard, so I'm sure my father will be happy to help out with one little ask. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, we fill our bellies with exquisitely prepared eel lunch boxes, delivered swiftly to us via bullet train.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: A lucky bag! How exciting! I want to buy one too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Since she's so eager to get one, the two of us head to the local shopping mall together to pick up a lucky bag.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I wonder which shop I should buy one from? Oh, look! They have lucky bags with food and tea too!
choice_data_list: Want to give one of them a try, then?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes! Even if I'm not fond of all the food, I can simply share it, after all! Let's go over there!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Wow, just look at this line… It seems we'll be waiting a while, so why don't we play a game while we wait?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Let's try to guess where everyone who passes by is going!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Right, let's start with that man in the big jacket. I think he's heading into the coffee shop.
choice_data_list: I'm gonna say he's going to the bookstore on the upper floor.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ah, he went in the coffee shop! Hehe, that's one point to me! ♪ His tired face gave him away.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Playing a game really helped pass the time, didn't it? Let's head home and see what we got in our lucky bags!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After spending a fun time waiting in the line, we each manage to snag a lucky bag!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: New Year's calligraphy, huh? In that case, I want to try doing something on a big scale!
choice_data_list: You mean like a calligraphy performance?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Exactly! I'll have someone from my household buy us a giant brush and some calligraphy paper!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Luckily, with it being the New Year's holidays, nobody else is using the gym, so we're able to use it for our giant calligraphy session!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hm… I need to visualize the characters first, or else the balance will be off.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After standing in front of the paper to envision the characters, she lifts a brush that's as tall as she is, and dashes across the sheet.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: TAAAAKE THIS! AND THAT! HAH!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Wheeew! What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The words "Wish Fulfillment" are written in flowing and beautiful script across the paper!
